title: Ledger entries: entries, repayments, attachments, invoice lines, CSV import as application use cases; F14
statusReason: Static verification passes. typecheck, build and ALL DB tests (WP-1 to WP-5b) did not run: no Postgres and no node_modules here. Money-critical (entries, repayments); nothing is PASS until pnpm test:finance-db is green in the real checkout.

commit.workingTree: Uncommitted; cumulative with WP-2b to WP-5a; bound by content in fin-provenance-manifest.json (79 files, regenerated).

scopeNote: The roadmap counts 17 handlers for entries; 4 of them (2 receipt-link, 2 amortization) were already thin adapters from WP-2b and WP-4. 13 were extracted here.

also moved: MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES (still imported by the receipt-scan route)
stays in routes/finance.ts: required-field and positive-amount validation on create

behaviorChanges: F14: invoice-line replacement is one transaction (delete, insert, recompute amount). The amount update also carries user_id. Outcomes and messages unchanged.

Notifications (entry created, repayment posted) are loaded with a dynamic import inside the use cases so tests do not load Telegram, email or SSE modules; they remain fire-and-forget with errors swallowed, as before.
Everything else moved without logic edits.
knownDebt: Journal postings after create, update, repayment and import remain best-effort (.catch(() => {})), as before. An entry can exist without its journal if posting fails; reconciliation is out of scope.
Attachment bytes are stored as base64 text in the row, unchanged.
Invoice-line journal adjustment is computed after the transaction commits; a concurrent edit between commit and the adjustment can compute a stale delta (same class as the F5 residual).

ran.result: PASS, 0 findings (new wp5b-single-owner and wp5b-wiring; notify consumer contract moved to application/entries.ts; attachment function names made unique against the vault module)
27/27 pass (4 new; F4 and F5 gates now also inspect application/entries.ts; ratchet 31 to 18)

ran.check: syntax check of all new and changed .ts files

notRun: pnpm test:finance-db (incl. new wp5b-use-cases.db.test.ts, registered in the runner; finance_attachments and finance_invoice_lines added to the isolated-schema allowlist)
next: WP-6 Invoices (17 handlers in finance-invoices.ts plus lib/finance-invoice.ts and lib/invoice-pdf.ts). High risk; the recurring sweep's createAndSendRuleInvoice import moves with it.
